rationale.consistency: Mirrors zoekt-git-index flag names/help text and gitindex idioms; io.Writer-based subcommands and no cmd.OptionsFromFlags/profiler differ from siblings but are defensible.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles duplicate names, non-dir roots, missing -index, unmatched remove targets, .meta sidecars; but pruning deletes whole compound shards holding live repos, and any WalkDir permission error aborts discovery.
rationale.scope: Refactor into prepareRepository is needed for the read-only preview; README paragraph is small and relevant; no dead code.
rationale.readability: Clear split across discover/inventory/sync/main with useful doc comments; runSync is long but linear.
rationale.robustness: O_EXCL lock file has no stale-lock recovery after a crash; IndexState discards the IndexState() error; DeriveNameFromRepoConfig defaults to the new behaviour so unlisted callers silently change.
rationale.maintainability: Reimplements repo discovery instead of building on gitindex.FindGitRepos; the inverted opt-in flag is a footgun for future callers; otherwise well factored and easy to extend.
